Looking at the previous attempt: it emitted the **Markdown embed wrapper** (image tag + source footer) as if it were the `.fd` file itself. That's the bug — the `.fd` must contain the FigDown source (spec line, `figdown` header, blocks, edges), not a Markdown embed. Below is the corrected `alert-forwarding-chain.fd`.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Alert-forwarding chain"

block probe "Probe"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block sink "Sink"

edge probe -> normalizer via=(60,20),(90,40)
edge normalizer -> sink
```

To embed it in the host Markdown document, keep the wrapper you had, unchanged, alongside the built SVG:

```markdown
![Alert-forwarding chain: probe feeds normalizer, which feeds sink](figures/alert-forwarding-chain.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/alert-forwarding-chain.fd](figures/alert-forwarding-chain.fd)</sub>
```

Next step: run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js alert-forwarding-chain.fd` — if `edge … via=(x,y),(x,y)` isn't the exact waypoint spelling this engine's `block`/`scene` reference uses, the validator will name the correct one; I didn't have `reference/scene.md`/`reference/layout.md` open in this session to confirm the literal waypoint keyword, so treat that line as the one to check first.
